items.problem: Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 fails hard on a near-miss anchor guess (no valid-anchor list, no fuzzy match), so the agent abandoned the tool after 2 failed manifest lookups and never fetched any pattern.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 16-18 (lines 1914-1943): `-Anchor manifest-migration-checklist` and `-Anchor manifest` both error; only 2 Get-MigrationPattern invocations all migration, both failed.
items.root_cause: The not-found branch printed a dead-end error; valid anchors are neither surfaced on failure nor fully enumerated anywhere (unsupported-api-inventory.json omits csproj/manifest/startup-crashes/etc.).
items.change: In Get-MigrationPattern.ps1, parse all `<a id>` anchors up front; on an exact miss, auto-resolve a UNIQUE bidirectional case-insensitive substring match (guess-contains-anchor OR anchor-contains-guess); if still unresolved, error out listing every available anchor.
items.expected_effect: A wrong anchor guess resolves in one turn (unique match) or immediately shows the agent the exact valid set, eliminating tool abandonment.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, `Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor manifest-migration-checklist` returns the manifest section (WARNING: resolved to 'manifest'); any bogus anchor prints the full anchor list. Verified: tested manifest-migration-checklist -> resolves; zzz -> lists 19 anchors.

items.problem: The Manifest migration checklist (the one artifact every UWP app carries) was unreachable via the documented fetch mechanism: it had no `<a id>` anchor and SKILL.md linked to a non-resolvable markdown slug.
items.evidence: grep '<a id=' MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md had no manifest anchor; SKILL.md L158 linked #manifest-migration-checklist-windowsdesktop--runfulltrust; agent's `-Anchor manifest` failed.
items.root_cause: Anchor was never added when the manifest section was written; SKILL.md advertised a slug the tool cannot consume.
items.change: Add `` above '### Manifest migration checklist' in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md; change SKILL.md link to `Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor manifest`.
items.expected_effect: Agents can fetch the manifest checklist (incl. the 0x80080204 background-task-extension fix) via the standard mechanism, preventing launch-failure zero-scores in scenarios whose manifest carries such an extension.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, `Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor manifest` returns the checklist. Verified: returns the section heading + body.
